summary: GRI 415 covers public policy, including an organization's participation in developing public policy through lobbying and financial or in-kind contributions to political parties, politicians or causes. It notes the associated risks of corruption, bribery and undue influence.

questions.text: How does your organization manage the topic of public policy, including its impacts, policies, actions and tracking of effectiveness?
questions.hint: Report how the organization manages this material topic using Disclosure 3-3 in GRI 3: Material Topics 2021.

questions.text: What is the total monetary value of financial and in-kind political contributions your organization made, directly and indirectly, by country and recipient/beneficiary?
questions.hint: a. Total monetary value of financial and in-kind political contributions made directly and indirectly, by country and recipient/beneficiary. b. If applicable, how the monetary value of in-kind contributions was estimated.
